headword: {冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}

definitions.explanation: Food that has been preserved by freezing and is stored at very low temperatures. Includes ready-made meals, vegetables, meat, and other items.

examples.japanese: {冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}を{電子|でんし}レンジで{温|あたた}める。
examples.english: I heat up frozen food in the microwave.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}の{冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}はとても{美味|おい}しい。
examples.english: Recent frozen foods are very delicious.

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しいときは{冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}に{頼|たよ}る。
examples.english: When I'm busy, I rely on frozen food.

examples.japanese: {冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}コーナーで{新商品|しんしょうひん}を{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found a new product in the frozen food section.

examples.japanese: うちの{冷凍庫|れいとうこ}はいつも{冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}でいっぱいだ。
examples.english: Our freezer is always full of frozen foods.

notes:
Compound of {冷凍|れいとう} (freezing) + {食品|しょくひん} (food product). Covers ready-made meals, frozen vegetables, meat, and other items stored at low temperatures.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}コーナー: frozen food section (in a store)
- {冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}を{解凍|かいとう}する: to defrost frozen food
- {冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}を{常備|じょうび}する: to keep frozen food in stock
- {冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}を{電子|でんし}レンジで{温|あたた}める: to heat frozen food in the microwave

RELATED TERMS:
- {冷凍庫|れいとうこ}: freezer
- {解凍|かいとう}: defrosting, thawing
- {加工食品|かこうしょくひん}: processed food
- {生鮮食品|せいせんしょくひん}: fresh food

CULTURAL NOTE:
Frozen food quality in Japan is notably high. {冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん} are widely used for {弁当|べんとう} (lunch boxes) and quick meals.
